name: NEXUS Command Center
architecture_type: Local PowerShell HTTP daemon and HTML5 Space HUD dashboard
knowledge_value: Primary operations orchestrator for the local developer runtime, telemetry, and system processes
governance_notes: Must not run destructive local processes
Port 9999 strictly bound to localhost for security
security_notes: Path verification before system invocation
Command validation to prevent shell injection

decision_log.rationale: Establish an offline, high-speed, agent-readable architecture mapping layer before scaling up to centralized graphs

notes: The bedrock control panel of the entire local NEXUS development loop.

name: Omega Ops Dashboard
architecture_type: React + Vite + TypeScript Single Page Application with Supabase client bindings
knowledge_value: Central business operations portal for managing workforce, payroll calculating, clearance engine, and policies compliance
governance_notes: Staff data must comply with Egyptian Labor Law
Salary variables require direct double-entry approvals
security_notes: Client credentials hidden from build targets
Private staff details require service_role clearances

decision_log.rationale: Moved work regulation policies into active SQL and dynamic gateway API layer for agent query readiness

notes: Main operational backbone of Omega Commercial Enterprises.

name: Recruitment Hub
architecture_type: React + Vite + TypeScript Call Center Portal with Streamlit automation bridges
knowledge_value: Acquisition and automated intake pipeline for candidate screening, call audits, and onboarding queues
workflow_patterns: Clearance check trigger before Staff promotion
governance_notes: Applicant CVs are highly sensitive and must be stored privately
Clearance validation is non-optional before Omega Staff inserts
security_notes: No raw CV PDFs may be committed to git repositories
Signed storage URLs are used exclusively

decision_log.decision: Integrated Call Center into main Recruitment Dashboard
decision_log.rationale: Unify applicant review interfaces to accelerate candidates to accepted status

notes: Crucial candidate ingestion layer, serving as the front door of workforce acquisition.

name: Asset Hub
architecture_type: React + TypeScript + Supabase database operations portal
knowledge_value: High-fidelity real estate and fleet asset lifecycle monitoring, tenancy, leasing, and operational costs
governance_notes: Fleet assets require Egyptian license checks
Tenancy agreements must be registered legally
security_notes: RLS controls locked down for financial columns
Access restricted to executive/finance roles

decision_log.rationale: Segregate asset management modules from core operations to secure sensitive revenue layers

notes: Also known as AL-Sebaei Asset Hub. Currently undergoing initial onboarding review.

name: Telegram Personal Agent
architecture_type: Python + Python-Telegram-Bot + LangChain / OpenAI API daemon running in WSL
knowledge_value: Conversational assistant (Malik) bridging on-site commanders with centralized Supabase operations and task logs
runtime_patterns: Authorized REST requests with x-agent-key headers
agent_patterns: Task creator and persistent synchronization driver
workflow_patterns: Telegram task creation -> API Gateway push -> nexus_tasks table insert
Direct staff record profile search in conversational Arabic
governance_notes: Agent must never reveal candidate salary data without executive key
Agent must refuse commands from unregistered Telegram IDs
security_notes: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and internal keys must remain in ignored .env files
Subprocess execution strictly audited

decision_log.rationale: Safeguard API endpoint gateways after deploying persistent task synchronization schemas

notes: Operational bridge for supervisors in the field to manage Omega Dashboard commands on the fly.

name: Omega API Gateway
architecture_type: Node.js + Express + TypeScript API gateway bundled with esbuild and Pino logging
knowledge_value: Secure transaction API layer for Supabase connections, agent verification, tasks intake, and dynamic policies
architecture_patterns: Seamless live-db to static-json fallback interfaces
governance_notes: Must enforce RLS policies during read/write loops
Must reject unauthenticated external requests
security_notes: No database passwords are saved in environment variables
Authentication checks cannot be bypassed

decision_log.rationale: Enable secure access via either standard user JWT or cryptographic Agent keys (x-agent-key)

notes: The secure gateway guarding access to all internal operations data.

name: Company Policies Runtime Engine
architecture_type: SQL Schema constraints and REST compliance evaluator gateway routes
knowledge_value: Immutable legal Egyptian labor compliance articles and dynamic runtime constraints evaluator
governance_notes: Original legal text must be preserved as immutable source truth
Edits are strictly limited to runtime severity and scope overrides
security_notes: Mass updates are strictly blocked by RLS policies
All overrides must be fully signed and recorded

decision_log.decision: Added dynamic Postgres full-text search capability
decision_log.rationale: Empower Malik agent to search Arabic regulations via localized, high-speed queries

notes: Operationalizes standard legal requirements directly into the operational software runtime.
